body:
## Context

Picker currently spawns fzt with a pre-generated YAML tree of the entire filesystem (via Everything). This doesn't scale — `.git/objects`, `node_modules`, and `$Recycle.Bin` directories consume the result limit (even at 50,000), and folder-only mode was generating empty YAML (fixed in `insert_dir` → `insert_file` on walker.rs:214).

The fundamental problem: fzt loads everything upfront, but file systems are too large for that. Picker needs lazy loading, which is architecturally different from fzt's current model.

## Design Decision

fzt is actually two things: an **engine** (fuzzy scoring, tree navigation, ANSI rendering, scope management, keyboard handling) and a **frontend** (CLI tool that loads YAML/stdin upfront). Picker is a second frontend that shares the engine but has a fundamentally different data lifecycle.

### fzt-core library extraction

Extract the engine into a reusable Go package (`fzt-core`) with a provider interface:

```go
type TreeProvider interface {
    LoadChildren(path string) []TreeNode
}
```

- **YAML provider**: loads the full tree into memory upfront (current behavior, used by CLI and homepage)
- **Directory provider**: reads one directory at a time on scope push (used by picker)

The rendering, ANSI output, keyboard handling, scope navigation, cursor management — all shared. Only the data source differs.

### Picker frontend behavior

- **Initial tree**: drive roots only (C:, D:, etc.)
- **Focused path**: pre-expand the path the calling app requested (e.g., `C:\Users\upstairspc` → walk and expand C: → Users → upstairspc → show immediate children)
- **Lazy loading**: when user pushes scope into an unexpanded folder, read that directory from the filesystem
- **Scope back to drives**: backspace/escape always allows navigating back up to the drive list
- **No Everything dependency**: direct filesystem reads, not indexed queries
- **Exclude junk**: skip `.git`, `node_modules`, `$Recycle.Bin` directories

### New fzt parameter: `--search-depth=N`

- `--search-depth=1`: search only matches within the current scope level (picker use case)
- Omitted: infinite depth search (current default, used by CLI/homepage bookmarks)

## Motivation

fzt is already used in three contexts — CLI (`at`/automate), WASM (homepage bookmarks), and picker (file dialog replacement). The library split makes it easy to build new frontends without fighting a monolith. Each new frontend reuses the visual layer and engine, only defining how data enters the system.

## Bugs fixed in this session (already in working tree, not yet committed)

- `walker.rs:214`: `insert_dir` → `insert_file` for `folders_only` mode (tree was empty because leaf directories had no files, so `has_content()` returned false)
- `walker.rs`: added `.git`, `$Recycle.Bin`, `node_modules` exclusions to Everything query
- `walker.rs`: bumped result limit from 10,000 to 50,000 (insufficient fix, superseded by this redesign)
title: Extract fzt-core library and rebuild picker as a frontend
